text.body:
NAK 5-86 = NGMPP B 24/34
'Parikramapadopāmikāpadmaprasaraśca'
misread for Parikramapadopāyikā karmaprasaraś ca
% most likely the first folio of a Vajrasattvodayā ms. [= Tōh. 2517]
% a rare work of Ānandagarbha!
[1\verso] \siddham namaḥ śrīvajrasattvāya||
vajrasattvaṃ jagannāthaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ||
% vajrasattvaṃ] \emend, vajrasattva˚ \ms
% praṇipatya] \corr, pranipatya \ms
sādhanopāyikāṃ vakṣye vajrasattvodayāṃ śubhām||
% śubhām] \emend, śubhaṃ \ms
tatrāryatattvasaṅgrahamahātantravidhinā vajradhātumahāmaṇḍale labdhasamayādikasya yogina āryavajrasattvārādhanavidhiḥ samuccīyate||
% labdha˚] \emend, labda˚ \ms
% ˚samayādikasya] \emend, ˚samayādhikasya \ms
% yogina] \corr, yoginaḥ|| \ms
% ˚vidhiḥ] \emend, ˚vidhi \ms
prathamaṃ tāvan nairātmyādhimuktyādhyātmikasnānaṃ kṛtvā hrīḥkāreṇa kaṇṭhadeśe aṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ jihvāpadmadale ca hūṃkāreṇa śuklaṃ pañcasūcikaṃ vajraṃ niṣpādyānenādhitiṣṭhet[–] vajrajihveti||
% kṛtvā] \corr, kṛtvā| \ms
% hrīḥkāreṇa] \emend, hrīkārena \ms
% ˚dale ca] \emend, ˚dale \ms
% śuklaṃ] \emend, śukla˚ \ms
karadvaye tv akārābhyāṃ candramaṇḍaladvayaṃ tayor upari hūṃkārābhyāṃ ca pañcasūcikaṃ vajradvayaṃ vicintya karasākhya[!?] caiva sūciṃ[!] vighnaghātādikaṃ kuryāt||
% karasākhya] \ms\pcorr, karasākhyā \ms\acorr
tatra hūṃkāreṇa vajrajvālānalārkam ātmānaṃ nirmāya\{||\} oṃ gṛhṇa vajra samaya hūṃ vam ity udīrayan\{|\} krodhaterintirīṃ badhnīyāt|
vajrabandhaṃ tale kṛtvā chādayet kruddhamānasaḥ[|]
% chādayet] \emend, cchādaye \ms
% kruddha˚] \emend, krurddha˚ \ms
gādham aṅguṣṭhavajreṇa krodhaterintirī smṛtā||
% Q STTS 1,438,1052
tato vajrārdhāsanaṃ niṣaṇṇo vajraterintirīṃ badhvā vajramālābhiṣekaṃ gṛhṇīyāt|| oṃ vajrajvālānalārka hūṃ abhiśiñca mām iti vajrabandhe 'ṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ saṃhatotthitaṃ vajrabandhasyopari śliṣṭaṃ dhārayet| vajraterintirī||
% 'ṅgu[2\recto]ṣṭhadvayaṃ
% saṃhatotthitaṃ] \emend, saṃhatotsthitaṃ \ms
oṃ ṭum ity anena dvyakṣarakavacena kavacayitvā\{||\} oṃ vajrajvālānalārka hūm ity udīrayet| vāmavajramuṣṭiṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā dakṣiṇena vajramuṣṭim ullālayan sarvavighnān hanyāt||
% hūm ity] \corr, hūṃ mity
% ullālayan] \corr, ullālayaṃ \ms
tato vajrānalena mudrāsahitena vighnadahanādikaṃ kuryāt| oṃ vajrānala daha paca matha bhañja raṇa phaḍ iti udīrayan| abhyantaravajrabandhe 'ṅgulijvālāgarbhe 'ṅguṣṭhavajram utthitam iyaṃ vajrānalasamayamudrā||
tadanu|
vajranetrī bandha sarvavighnān iti mudrāyuktayā sarvavighnabandhaṃ kuryāt|| vajrabandhaṃ badhvā aṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ prasārya samaṃ dhārayet|| vajranetrīmudrā||
prasāritavajrabandhaṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpyādhobandhaṃ kuryāt| oṃ vajra dṛḍho me bhava rakṣa sarva[ṃ?] svāheti||
% ˚ṣṭhāpyādho˚] \corr, ˚sthāpya 'dho˚ \ms
vajrabhairavanetreṇa mudrāsahitenordhvabandhaṃ kuryāt|| oṃ hulu 2 hūṃ phaḍ iti| vajramuṣṭidvayaṃ badhvālātacakravad bhramayitvā śirasa upari tarjanyaṅkuśākāreṇa dhārayet| vajrabhairavanetramudrā||
% badhvālātacakravad] \emend, badhvā 'lātacakra \ms
% tarjanyaṅkuśākāreṇa] \emend, tarjanyāṃkyaśākāreṇa \ms
tasyādhastāt vajrayakṣeṇa mudrāsahitena punaḥ tatraiva bandhaṃ kuryāt| oṃ vajrayakṣa hūm iti| vajrāñjalir aṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ prasāritatarjanīdvayaṃ daṃṣṭravajrayakṣasya mudrā||
% ˚yakṣeṇa [2\verso] mudrā˚
% hūm iti] \corr, hūṃ miti \ms
% ˚tarjanīdvayaṃ] \emend, ˚tarjanīdvaya \ms
% daṃṣṭra˚] \emend, draṃṣṭra˚ \ms
vajroṣṇīṣeṇa mudrāyuktena pūrvaṃ diśaṃ bandhayet| oṃ druṃ bandham iti drum iti vā| vajramuṣṭidvayaṃ kanyasā[!] śṛṅkhalabandhena tarjanīdvayasūcīmukhaṃ parivarttyoṣṇīṣe sthāpayet| vajroṣṇīṣamudrā||
% iti drum] \ms\pcorr, iti vā drum \ms\acorr
punar vajrapāśena tām eva bandhayet| hūṃ vajrapāśa hrīḥ iti| vajramuṣṭidvayena bāhyagranthiṃ kuryāt| vajrapāśamudrā||
% punar] \emend, punaḥ \ms\pcorr, puna \ms\acorr
vajrapatākayā paścimāṃ| oṃ vajrapatāke pataṅgiri raṭ| iti vajrabandhe 'ṅguṣṭhasattvaparyaṅkaṃ sūcīkṛtāgrā samānāmā vidāritābhyāṃ paṭṭāgrī| vajrapatākāyāḥ||
% paścimāṃ] \emend, paścimāyāṃ \ms
% ˚vidāritābhyāṃ] \emend, vidāritāṃ bhyā \ms\pcorr, vidāritābhyā \ms\acorr
% ˚patākāyāḥ] \emend, vajrapatākayāḥ \ms
vajrakālyottarāṃ| oṃ hrīḥ vajrakāli raṭ maḍ iti|| vajrayakṣamudraiva mukhe dṛḍhīkṛtā[|] vajrakālyāḥ||
% ottarāṃ|] \emend, ˚ottarā \ms
vajraśikharayā dakṣiṇāṃ| oṃ vajraśikhare ruṭ maḍ iti| vajramuṣṭidvayena parvatotkarṣābhinayā| vajraśikharayāḥ||
% ˚śikhārāyāḥ] \emend, ˚śikharayāḥ \ms
vajrakarmaṇā maṇḍalabandhaṃ kṛtvā prākāraṃ dadyāt| oṃ vajrakarmeti||
punar abhyantaraprā-
